name: with_modifier
note: `with` rewrites the input the body sees. The body reads only the overridden field and the input does not carry it, so OPA allows and a converter that dropped the modifier would deny -- this fixture fails rather than passes if the silent drop ever comes back. Recorded as SKIP today because rego2ast refuses the construct.
rego:
package authz

allow if input.y == 2 with input.y as 2
